const { inferContact } = require('../../../libraries/infer-contact.js');

module.exports = async ({ ctx, settings }) => {
  const jetpack = require('fs-jetpack');
  const { wait } = require('node-powertools');
  const fs = require('node:fs');

  await wait(1);

  return ctx.respond({ ok: jetpack.exists(settings.path) && fs.existsSync(settings.path) });
};
